Tessa / Lauren — reviewing quickly. Policy notes: H100-equivalent reservations are typically reserved for enterprise-tier commitments; for Reserved Dedicated we try to standardize on the N-class SKU to preserve pool fungibility. That said, we have a few levers to make a short-term exception:

Option A (preferred, lower revenue risk): Offer H100-equivalent priority override for 6 weeks starting 07/05, capped burst 200 GPU-hrs/day, but set the burst overage surcharge at +20% of committed rate (not 10%). Require a 30% prepayment on the reserved commit to compensate for capacity reallocation.

Option B (revenue-neutral): Keep reserved SKU as standard N-class; provide a temporary H100 soft-affinity routing during low-util windows (best-effort), and allow burst up to 120 GPU-hrs/day at +10% surcharge. No prepay.

Commercial impact (rough): Option A reduces short-term available H100 capacity by 8 units for the window and increases risk of opportunity cost. We can price-protect by taking the prepayment and a 6-week term addendum. Attached rough calc in-line: incremental revenue delta vs standard = ~$42k over 6 weeks (assuming 8 units and current listed H100 premium).

Given StellarMed’s timeline and the ask for an answer by Friday, this needs executive signoff for an SKU override and material prepayment term. Jonas — can you weigh in (approve Option A with the 30% prepay + 20% overage), or suggest alternate approval? If yes, we’ll circulate SOW amendment + DocuSign link and notify customer.

Attachments referenced: quick-pricing-notes (internal).

- Aditya

Subject: Approval: conditional H100 priority override for StellarMed (DEAL-7831)

Team — after reviewing the ask and the Deal Desk recommendation, I approve a conditional exception under the following terms: 

1) Grant a priority override to H100-equivalent reserved capacity for StellarMed for a six-week window: 2027-07-05 through 2027-08-15. (Start window may shift ±3 days if ops needs lead time.)

2) Temporary burst allowance up to 200 GPU-hours/day during the window. Bursts are subject to the following cap: total burst consumption for the window cannot exceed 6,800 GPU-hours (200 * 34 days max).

3) Overage surcharge: set at +20% of the committed reserved rate for any burst consumption above included reserved hours. StellarMed proposed 10%; Deal Desk made a business case for 20% to offset H100 opportunity cost — approved.

4) Financial guardrails: require 30% prepayment on the reserved portion prior to start; include a short SOW amendment that enumerates the SKU override, burst cap, and overage rate. Legal to apply a 6-week addendum with acceptance via DocuSign.

5) Operational note: Ops must mark the reservation as non-preemptible for the override window and tag it "STELLARMED-H100-PRIORITY-OVR" to avoid accidental reallocation.

Tessa — please confirm with StellarMed and circulate the SOW amendment + DocuSign link. Aditya / Lauren — coordinate the billing/credit memo and make sure accounting gets the prepayment invoice queued. Ops: flag capacity and schedule the SKU mapping.

Jonas Weber
VP, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference
